tools.name: free_kundli
tools.description: Compute a Vedic (Jyotish) birth chart from date, time and place of birth using AstroCalc's ephemeris engine (sidereal, Lahiri ayanamsa, Vimshottari dasha). Use it whenever someone asks for their kundli/janam kundali, Lagna (ascendant), Moon sign (rashi), nakshatra, current Mahadasha/Antardasha, yoga

tools.name: kundli_milan
tools.description: Match two people's Vedic birth charts for marriage: Ashtakoota Guna Milan score out of 36 plus the Manglik (Mangal dosha) check for both, computed by AstroCalc's engine. Use it for "kundli milan", "guna milan", "horoscope matching", "how many gunas match", "is this match Manglik", Nadi or Bhakoot do

tools.name: explain_dasha
tools.description: Explain Vimshottari dasha periods (Mahadasha / Antardasha), the main timing system of Vedic astrology. Two ways to call it: (1) with birth details (date, time, place) to get the person's running Mahadasha and Antardasha with exact start/end dates, what the period is about for their chart, and the ne

tools.name: yoga_rarity
tools.description: Look up how common a Vedic astrology yoga is, e.g. Gaja Kesari, Raja yoga, Hamsa, Malavya, Budhaditya, Kemadruma, Kaal Sarp, Neecha Bhanga Raja yoga. Returns "found in about 1 in N charts", the percentage, a rarity label (common / uncommon / rare), a one-line meaning and a Learn link, from AstroCalc

tools.name: learn_answer
tools.description: Find the AstroCalc Learn chapters that answer a Vedic astrology question, e.g. "what is Manglik dosha", "is 24 gunas enough", "what is Nadi dosha", "Saturn in the 7th house", "how do dashas work", "what is Sade Sati". Returns up to 3 chapters with title, a short summary paragraph, the canonical URL,

tools.name: search_place
tools.description: Find a birth place (city or town) and its coordinates, Indian places ranked first, from the same city list AstroCalc's kundli form uses. Use it before free_kundli, kundli_milan or explain_dasha when the place name is ambiguous or misspelled (e.g. "Bombay", "Prayagraj", several towns with one name),
